description.text: Teaching ObjectivesThe course aims to educate students to study basic theory and elementary knowledge in medicine, gain basic clinical skills of some common diseases diagnosis processing, have the primary treatment ability to urgent, difficult and severe symptoms, and be qualified for careers in hospitals, the medical and health units, medical science research departments as well as other organizations related medicine.Main CoursesHistology & Embryology, Cell Biology, Biochemistry, Physiology, Microbiology, Immunology, Pathology, Pathophysiology, Topography, Medical Statistics, Epidemiology, Hygiene, Pharmacology, Clinical Diagnostics, Ultrasound, Medical Imageology, Internal Medicine, Neurology & Psychiatry, Pediatrics, Ophthalmology, Otolaryngology, Dermatology, Stomatology, Clinical Psychology, Pediatrics etc.Fee StructureTuition: 45000rmb/yearDouble Room: 6000rmb per year per personStudy Duration6 years (including 1-year Clinical Practice)InternshipThe 6 years including 1 to 1.5 years compulsory internship. The internship can be finished in Chinese hospitals or in hospitals of your own country.Degree AwardedOn completing the requirements of the teaching program and passing the graduation examinations successfully, international medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by Southern Medical University , if they meet the degree regulations of Southern Medical University. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery).CareerAfter obtaining MBBS Degree, the graduates can apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council in order to get registered and practice medicine. According to the regulations in different countries, the students may need to do the degree accreditation first. A MBBS degree holder can find jobs in government as well as private hospitals, nursing homes and other health facilities. Except this, one can also start his own clinic or pursue study for master's degree.

duration.text: The Clinical Medicine at Southern Medical University is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) Scanned copyof valid passport’s information page;(2)Scanned copyof notarized highest Academic Degree Certificate, Expected Graduation Certificatefor fresh graduates (original one and English-translated one. After being pre-admitted, applicants are required to submit final Graduation Certificate to be eligible for official admission.);(3) Scanned copies of transcriptof all courses during the highest academic degree education(original one and English-translated one);(4) Study Plan: A minimum of 1000 words for master’s degree applicants (general scholars) and a minimum of 1500 words for doctoraldegree applicants (senior scholars) written in Chinese (Chinese medium applicants) or English (English medium applicants). The content includes personal studying and working experiences, academic research achievements, research and learning plans during master or doctoral study, personal developing goals after graduation, etc.;(5)Two original copies of recommendation letters written by professors or associate professors in Chinese or English (with signatures and contact information); only postgraduate candidates are required to submit;(6) Provisional Acceptance Letter from a professor of Southern Medical University(only postgraduate candidates are required to submit);(7)Scanned copy of Foreigner's Physical Examination Formcompleted in Chinese or English;(8)Certificate of language proficiency;(9) Police Clearance Certificate(10)ID photo (2-inch blue background photo without hats);(11) English or Chinese self-introduction video (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M).

requirements.text: Applicants should be non-Chinese citizensholding a valid foreign passport.If both parents or one of the parents of the applicant are Chinese citizens and reside in a foreign country, the applicant should have foreign nationality at birth and hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years. In addition, a record of more than 2 years of actual residence in a foreign country in the last 4 years (by April 30, 2025)is also needed. For people immigrating fromChinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan to foreign countries and are applying as international students, please refer to the requirements above.Applicants should bephysically and mentally healthy, and meet the medical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit in China.Age Limit and Education Background Requirements:(1)Undergraduate students: under the age of 30, with a diploma comparable to the High School Diploma in China..(2)Master’sstudents: under the age of 35, with a degree comparable to the Bachelor’s Degree in Chinese universities.(3)Doctoral students: under the age of 40, with a degree comparable to the Master’s Degree in Chinese universities.(4) General Scholar: under the age of 45, with a degree comparable to the Bachelor’s Degree in Chinese universities.(5) Senior Scholar: under the age of 50, with a degree comparable to the Master’s Degree in Chinese universities.4. Applicants should have excellent gradesand good conduct,without any record of violation of school rules and regulations, nor any record of public security punishmentor criminal record.5. Applicants shouldhave excellent grades and clear purpose of studyingin China, with aGPA of 3.0 or above in the previous academic yearwithoutfailing or repeated subjects.6. LanguageProficiency Requirements:(1) Master’s /Doctoral ProgramsChinese Medium Program:Applicantsmust reach a score above 180 in HSK 5or provide other comparable certificates proving Chinese proficiency.English Medium Program:Applicantsfrom non-English-speaking countries must reach a score above 90 in TOEFL(20 or above for each item) or 6.5 in IELTS(6.0 or above for each item); or provide other comparable certificates proving English proficiency. Applicants from English-speaking countriesor receiving the last degree with the instruction in English are exempt from submitting the English proficiency certificates, but the certificate of English medium issued by the school graduated from shall be provided.
